description: Story Phase 6 (The Death Rattle of the S.E.S.; The Midnight Stenchmaster Catastrophe) has begun: sunset, a few days after Phase 5.
Sunset: the captain checked on Squawks ('Garrick food. Bad.').
The captain is carrying Squawks's basket (cleared when he's set down).
Garrick ate the rotten garlic (DO NOT EAT / BADLY SPOILED) and raw onions in the galley. YOUR WORKPLACE IS YOUR TROUSERS. (Permanent.)
Supper moved outdoors, with the chair ('Seat warming').
Chapter 26: The Frog Tax Man (night).
The S.E.S. has a recurring programme: The Frog Tax Man (channel 7). (Permanent.)
The captain watched The Frog Tax Man with Garrick ('He took the STANDARD deduction!').
Garrick fell asleep in his chair in the suit, the set on full volume.
Bob woke the captain ('I enjoy being alive'). 'Captain brave.' 'Captain foolish.'
On deck at night: the set sparking at full volume, Garrick asleep beside it.
Garrick would not wake ('Five more minutes').
The captain found OFF MAYBE on the set's knob panel and it worked (eventually).
Chapter 27: The Machine Refuses to Die.
Rook and Sully, woken by the honk, came up to look at the dying set.
Rook moved back from the dying set.
Sully moved back from the dying set.
Smouldering spot by the chair smothered.
Smouldering spot by the grog table smothered.
Smouldering seam at the mainmast smothered.
The Frog Grog barrel the set was wired into has been rolled away. (Do not seek logic.)
The S.E.S. threw a fork into the mainmast. It's still there.
The death rattle: BEEEE-OOOOP, REMEMBER TO FILE BY APRIL FIFTEENTH, POP.
An ember singed the Grand Stenchmaster's painted cape (THE FIRST ONE is mostly gone). The captain thought about it first. (Permanent.)
Chapter 28: The Worst Morning (dawn).
The morning Shark Duty wave is over.
Garrick found out: WHO TURNED IT OFF? / Ceremonial snoring / THE CAPE / a difficult shutdown.
'Throw it overboard.' It wasn't: a shark, the rowboat and the chaos intervened. The S.E.S. stayed. (Permanent.)
Garrick spent the day in the rowboat on a line astern (and came back by night; nobody remembers how).
Chapter 29: The Burning Warning (that night).
Squawks is in his tiny sleeping cap (the night of the catastrophe).
The captain grabbed Squawks: 'Nothing is going to happen to ye this time.'
Bob got moving ('I can't feel my legs').
Wick got moving (Thursday's RUNNING).
Brask got moving (and didn't shoot anything).
'Pressure shift.' 'It moved.' 'Where?' 'Down.'
Everyone out of the sleeping quarters and up on deck.
Refuge: not below (it traps it).
Refuge: not the barrel (it STAYS).
Refuge: not the washing (you need to breathe).
Refuge: not the rowboat (sharks).
Refuge: not the rigging (clouds go up).
Refuge: not the cabin (enclosed rooms).
There is nowhere. 'BIGGER.' 'No.'
Squawks wrapped in the captain's coat for the blast. 'Tradition starts somewhere.'
Chapter 30: The Mightiest Gust Yet.
The second major release: the ship inflated, vented through every seam, and fired a broadside into empty sea. (Permanent.)
The Second Yellow Apocalypse: a new Dead Center (generation 2), garlic-pale and worse.
Got aft, clear of the second cloud.
'Still here.' 'Still ANGRY.'
THE GREAT SHARKSTORM formed beside the ship. Garrick named it. Nobody wanted him to. (Permanent.)
Chapter 31: The Great Sharkstorm.
Starboard shrouds secured.
Port shrouds secured.
Quarterdeck braces secured.
Squawks in the cabin doorway, with Fennimore guarding him.
A shark on deck, heaved overboard by four crew and the captain. 'Put me back.'
A flying shark came through the rail and into the S.E.S. ('Ribbit... tax deduction...' POP). THEY'RE ALL GRAY. (Permanent.)
Squawks in a blanket pouch on the captain's chest, at the helm.
The captain's monologue: FIX IT. Garrick: 'No.'
Chapter 32: Another Ocean.
A barrel of concentrated Frog Grog is waiting at the port rail.
All sixteen barrels of the bulk Frog Grog reserve went into the Great Sharkstorm. (Inventory Frog Grog is untouched; more can be brewed.)
The near vortex collapsed. The crew think the storm is dead.
The Great Sharkstorm is NOT destroyed: it persists, far off on the horizon. (Permanent.)
Food ban (for Garrick): no more rotten garlic, EVER; also onions, beans, cabbage and cheese. (Permanent.)
The rowboat epilogue: smart shark; DETAILS!; Unfortunately.
Story Phase 6 is complete.
